cells.title: Add bee state session attach and name it in FIX lines
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue #147 (read it with gh issue view 147), per ab1c51bb. A host worktree guard refuses any shell text holding the word bind, so the remedy bee prints cannot be followed from a worktree session. Red first: in verbs/state_group/tests.rs add a test that runs state session attach --lane <f> --session-id <id> against a fixture lane and asserts the same session record result state session bind gives; watch it fail. Then route ["session", "attach", ..] to the same handler as ["session", "bind", ..] in set_gate.rs (search for the line ["session", "bind", ..] => ("session.bind", 2)), declare a state session attach entry in generated/registry_payload.json with the same flags as state session bind (command-surface R10), and bump PINNED_FLAG_COUNT in catalog.rs or any other count the catalog tests demand. Replace bind with attach in every FIX line under verbs/state_group that names bee state session bind (search: rg -n "state session bind" packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/state_group). Keep state session bind working unchanged. No code comments of any kind.

truths: bee state session attach --lane X --session-id Y gives the same result as bee state session bind with the same flags
Every FIX line under verbs/state_group names bee state session attach
bee state session bind still works unchanged

cells.title: Read slash, range and comma D-ID lists in feature-local decisions at close
cells.action: Fix GitHub issue #150 (read it with gh issue view 150), per ab1c51bb. In close.rs the feature_local_hit check (search: let feature_local_hit = local_decisions.iter().any) matches only the plain token feature D<n>, so a decision naming feature D2/D3/D4 or feature D1, D2, D3 routes only the first id. Red first: add tests in verbs/drivers/tests.rs, named with the word routing, that log one feature-local decision naming admin D2/D3/D4 and one naming admin D1, D2, D3, D4 and assert the routing door reports none of those ids unrouted; watch them fail. Then make feature_local_hit also accept context_table_covers_d_id over the decision text, and extend parse_d_sequence in context_table.rs (search: matches!(chars[end], '-' | '/')) so a comma plus optional spaces before D<digits> continues the list as exactly the named ids, the same as a slash. Ranges keep their meaning. No code comments of any kind.

truths: A feature-local decision naming feature D2/D3/D4 routes D2, D3 and D4
A feature-local decision naming feature D1, D2, D3, D4 routes all four
A bundle file citing feature D1, D3 covers exactly D1 and D3
prohibitions: Do not weaken an existing assertion

cells.title: Do not read synced bee-* skill trees as a dirty worktree at merge
cells.action: Fix GitHub issues #151 and #152 (read them with gh issue view), per ab1c51bb. worktree new copies every bee-* directory under each skill root of the main checkout into the new worktree (git.rs, search: if !is_dir || !name.starts_with("bee-")); in a repo where those trees are untracked, worktree merge then refuses WORKTREE_MERGE_WORKTREE_DIRTY on them (phases.rs, search: let mut dirty_exclusions = vec). Red first: in verbs/worktree/tests.rs add a test with a host-shaped main where .claude/skills is untracked and holds bee-x, a worktree with that synced copy, and assert merge does not refuse dirty; add a second test where an untracked .claude/skills/bee-new exists only in the worktree and assert merge still refuses dirty. Watch the first fail. Then add to the dirty exclusions exactly the bee-* skill directories that are untracked in the worktree AND exist under the same root in the main checkout, using the same skill-root list worktree new uses. No code comments of any kind.

truths: An untracked bee-* skill directory that also exists in main no longer makes worktree merge refuse as dirty
An untracked skill directory that exists only in the worktree still makes worktree merge refuse as dirty

artifacts.substantive: synced skill directories join the dirty exclusions

key_links: the exclusion uses the same skill roots worktree new syncs
